citation.title: Effect of immediate provisionalization using natural crowns with fiber splints on gingival contour and esthetic outcomes after immediate implant placement: a randomized clinical trial
citation.authors: Yiwen Wu, Haodong Wang, Xinhai Lin, Hongrun Zhou, Zhaowei Tai, Xuetao Deng, Lifen Li, Long Jiang

domains.evidence_quote: Participants were randomly allocated to an experimental group receiving immediate restoration using natural crowns combined with FRC splints and a control group receiving delayed restoration.

Postoperative pain and swelling were assessed using the visual analogue scale (VAS). At 4–5 months postoperatively, gingival esthetics were evaluated using the pink esthetic score (PES), and changes in gingival height (mesial papilla, distal papilla, and mid-labial gingival margin) were measured using intraoral optical scans.

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement anywhere in the text at all, or manufacturer funding without independent analysis
no sample size justification / power analysis (clinical studies)
follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: The abstract reports early healing and esthetic outcomes, not a survival claim requiring longer follow-up.

sources.fact_fa: این کارآزمایی بالینی تصادفی در پرسش درمانی، امتیاز ۴۷ و رتبه C دارد.
sources.interpretation_fa: چکیده از بهبود برخی پیامدهای زیبایی و کاهش ناراحتی پس از پروویژنال‌سازی فوری در مقایسه با ترمیم تأخیری گزارش می‌دهد. حجم نمونه ۲۰ نفر و پیگیری ۴ تا ۵ ماهه، ارزش نتیجه را به پیامدهای کوتاه‌مدت محدود می‌کند؛ چکیده برای قضاوت درباره اجرای روش‌شناختی جزئیات کافی ندارد.
